target.statement: PIN-14M dataset contains 14,573,216 documents (total document count for the PIN-14M release)

compute.basis: The target is a dataset-level count; reproducing it requires downloading the public PIN-14M dataset (or its metadata) and counting documents, which is I/O-bound and feasible on a laptop, though the full dataset is large.

blockers: No official code repository for the data processing pipeline is linked; only dataset links are provided.
The full PIN-14M dataset is large (millions of documents and images), requiring significant download time and disk space.
The exact count may depend on the specific version of the dataset on Hugging Face, which could change over time.
title: PIN: A Knowledge-Intensive Dataset for Paired and Interleaved Multimodal Documents
